title: Galatians Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Galatians 2: a visit to Jerusalem with Barnabas and Titus, the right hand of fellowship, the confrontation at Antioch, and being justified by faith.

questions.text: Whom did the writer take with him when he went up again to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: He says that after a period of fourteen years he went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with him.

answers.text: Peter and John
Barnabas and Titus
James and Cephas
Timothy and Luke

questions.text: What does the chapter say about Titus and circumcision?
questions.explanation: It says that not even Titus, who was with him and was a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

answers.text: He was not compelled to be circumcised
He was circumcised to please the Jews
He was sent away because of it
He was told to decide for himself

questions.text: Why were the false brothers secretly brought in?
questions.explanation: They stole in to spy out the liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, so that they might bring us into bondage.

answers.text: To carry a report back to Jerusalem
To collect money from the Gentiles
To learn the Good News for themselves
To spy out our liberty and bring us into bondage

questions.text: Who are named as those reputed to be pillars, who gave the right hand of fellowship?
questions.explanation: It says that James and Cephas and John, who were reputed to be pillars, gave Barnabas and the writer the right hand of fellowship.

answers.text: Andrew, Philip and John
Barnabas, Titus and James
James, Cephas and John
Cephas, Timothy and John

questions.text: What one thing did they ask of Barnabas and the writer?
questions.explanation: They only asked them to remember the poor, which the writer says he was also zealous to do.

answers.text: To report back every year
To remember the poor
To keep away from the Gentiles
To teach the law to the Greeks

questions.text: What did the writer do when Peter came to Antioch?
questions.explanation: He says he resisted Peter to his face, because Peter stood condemned.

answers.text: He welcomed him before the assembly
He kept silent about the matter
He wrote to James about him
He resisted him to his face

questions.text: What did Peter do when some people came from James?
questions.explanation: Before they came he ate with the Gentiles, but when they came he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

answers.text: He drew back and separated himself from the Gentiles
He went up to Jerusalem at once
He called the Gentiles together to teach them
He asked the writer to speak for him

questions.text: Who was carried away with the hypocrisy of the Jews there?
questions.explanation: It says the rest of the Jews joined Peter in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with it.

answers.text: Titus
James
Barnabas
John

questions.text: How does this chapter say a man is justified?
questions.explanation: It says a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

answers.text: Through faith in Jesus Christ, not by the works of the law
By the works of the law alone
By keeping the traditions of the fathers
By the judgment of those reputed to be pillars

questions.text: What does the writer say about his own life after being crucified with Christ?
questions.explanation: He says it is no longer he who lives, but Christ lives in him, and the life he now lives in the flesh he lives by faith in the Son of God.

answers.text: That he lives by the law of his fathers
That he lives as one who is already dead
That he lives for the praise of men
That it is no longer he who lives, but Christ lives in him
